reasoning: Both correctly walk the memory subtree, sum leaves for container subsystems, rank leaves in the top-N, and show id/abs frames. A passes StyLua, anchors the memory lookup at the root, and prints raw units. B fails StyLua, assumes the counters are bytes and converts to MB without support, and uses the iterator state less safely. A is the cleaner merge.

criteria.note: Uses OpenFromFile(process.args[2]) and error(`could not open {path}`), disposes session on all paths, but prints no usage line when the arg is missing.
FindCounterId("/memory") then getChildren via FirstChild/Sibling and getPath via Parent links; no hard-coded subsystems.

children()/fullPath via desc links plus a CounterIterator rooted at memoryId; the bare FindCounterId("memory") can match a nested node.
